answer: Wind writes every plume's path, and wind takes no bribes. Each ballot lights one plume at its own vertex; three downwind witnesses log arrival minute and peak concentration under the Gaussian plume model. A farm's plumes fail the echo test: a zenith relay pings every ballot, and two replies inside one second from a single vertex came from one throat, so both are grounded, bonds seized. Forging 10,000 ballots needs 10,000 fires, 10,000 echo replies in one tide, $25 pledged per ballot, $250,000 frozen in place. A plume copied twice is smoke without a fire.
